verdict.rationale: Navan ships its own natural-language interfaces. Navan Edge lets users book flights, hotels and restaurants by chatting, with explicit confirmation before booking, changing or canceling. The official hosted MCP server and Ava let users query and analyze spend, travel and policy data in natural language. Coverage of the product's operations is incomplete, though: Edge is a tier reserved for frequent travelers, and the MCP and Ava capabilities are documented mainly as querying and analysis rather than taking actions. Missing for 10: documented natural-language execution of expense workflows (submitting expenses, approvals, reimbursements, card actions) outside the reserved Edge tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the natural-language experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can book flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations by chatting with Navan Edge.
Navan Edge will always ask for your explicit confirmation before booking, changing, or canceling any trip.
The Navan MCP lets you connect Navan to your favorite AI products, so you can query Navan spend and travel data using natural language.
Ava slices and dices real-time spend data, provides insights into T&E questions, and proactively finds opportunities for savings.
Reserved for the world's most frequent travelers
